source.author: verg
source.text: Ipsa, Iovis rapidum iaculata e nubibus ignem, disiecitque rates evertitque aequora ventis, illum expirantem transfixo pectore flammas turbine corripuit scopuloque infixit acuto.
source.text_original: Ipsa, Iovis rapidum iaculata e nubibus ignem, / disiecitque rates evertitque aequora ventis, / illum expirantem transfixo pectore flammas / turbine corripuit scopuloque infixit acuto.
source.text_english: She herself, hurling Jove’s swift fire from the clouds, scattered the ships and overturned the seas with winds; that man, as he breathed out flames from his pierced breast, she snatched up in a whirlwind and fixed him on a sharp rock.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_original: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem / iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_english: I myself would already now have hurled rain and darkness and the savage trident, and my wife’s fire, though unwillingly.
